exposure: placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) status (based on histopathologic confirmation)
cohort: 100 third-trimester pregnant women with at least one previous cesarean delivery (CS) and anterior low-lying placenta or placenta previa
finding: The placenta accreta index (PAI) score, calculated based on various placental features, demonstrated good predictive accuracy (AUC of 0.84) for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) in a cohort of high-risk pregnant women.
